name: Baltic Biodiversity Grant (Bałtycki Grant Bioróżnorodności)
summary: Donation-based grants from the ORLEN Foundation for Pomerania for projects that protect Baltic Sea biodiversity, including habitat protection and regeneration and work on rare or threatened species; monitoring, innovation and education projects are also funded.

amount.note: Up to PLN 500,000 for projects meeting at least two programme goals; up to PLN 100,000 for education-only projects
